blocks.text: Propositional satisfiability logic ka concept hai jo check karta hai ke kya koi statement sach (true) ho sakta hai. Is se pata chalta hai ke kya kisi logical expression ki kam az kam ek aisi soorat hai jis mein woh sach ho. Yeh concept computer science mein, khaas taur par problem solving aur programming mein, bohat istemal hota hai. Satisfiability logical statements test karne aur faisle karne mein madad deti hai. Algorithms design karne aur programs ki jaanch (verify karne) ke liye yeh aham hai. Satisfiability samajhne se reasoning ki skill barhti hai aur mushkil masle jaldi hal hote hain.
“Pizza lao YA (burger lao AUR soda NA lao).”
Nateeja: pizza le aayein, soda na layein, to baat poori ho jati hai = satisfiable expression. Hal (solution) maujood hai.
“Pizza zaroor lao AUR pizza hargiz NA lao.”
Nateeja: koi hal nahi = unsatisfiable expression. Pizza lana aur na lana ek saath mumkin nahi.

blocks.title: Do You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Logical expression satisfiable hai agar usay sach banane ka kam az kam ek tareeqa ho.
Proposition ke satisfiable hone ki shartein

Proposition satisfiable hai agar truth values ka kam az kam ek combination usay sach bana de. Agar tamam mumkin combinations usay jhoot banayein to woh unsatisfiable hai. Satisfiability expression ki banawat (structure) aur us mein lage connectives par depend karti hai. AND, OR aur NOT jaise connectives tay karte hain ke statement sach ho sakta hai ya nahi. Truth table bana kar har soorat check karna satisfiability test karne ka ek tareeqa hai. Jis proposition ka kam az kam ek nateeja “true” ho, woh satisfiable hai. Yeh shart reasoning aur faisla karne mein kaam aati hai.
Satisfiable aur unsatisfiable expressions ki misalein

Satisfiable expression ki misal “P OR Q” hai: yeh tab sach hai jab P ya Q mein se koi sach ho. Doosri misal “P AND Q” hai, jo tab sach hai jab P aur Q dono sach hon. Unsatisfiable expression ki misal “P AND NOT P” hai: yeh kabhi sach nahi hota, kyunke P ek hi waqt mein sach aur jhoot dono nahi ho sakta. Satisfiable expressions ka kam az kam ek nateeja true hota hai, aur unsatisfiable ka koi bhi nahi. In misalon se logic aur problem solving samajh aati hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Teacher kuch expressions de aur students har ek ko satisfiable ya unsatisfiable mein classify karein (alag alag karein).

blocks.prompt: Kya (P OR Q) AND (NOT P) AND (NOT Q) satisfiable hai? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Nahi. NOT P aur NOT Q dono sach hone ke liye P aur Q dono jhoot hone chahiyein, lekin tab P OR Q jhoot ho jata hai. Is liye har row jhoot hai aur expression unsatisfiable hai.

items: Satisfiable: kam az kam ek combination par sach (jaise P OR Q).
Unsatisfiable: har combination par jhoot (jaise P AND NOT P).
Truth table ki saari rows dekh kar check karo.
